sentinels.purpose: Residual-sweep completeness sentinel. If a future read of the effective four-file package (base authority, authority amendment v1.0.1, and their two manifests) finds a string matching the eight patterns in v1.0.2's RESIDUAL_SWEEP_METHOD that is not listed in v1.0.2's classified_hits_from_* inventories, the sweep this manifest certifies is INCOMPLETE and must be re-run and re-published, not patched ad hoc. AP102-1 exercises this sentinel directly.

Ratification-gate sentinel, guarding against a subtler recurrence of B-1's own failure mode. SPC102-1 NARROWS OD-2.sub_decisions[1]'s SCOPE (from 'is a user-scope variable acceptable' to 'which process-scoped mechanism is selected'); it does NOT narrow OD-2's STANDING as one of the six owner decisions that must be RATIFIED before PHASE_P1. A future reader who reasons 'OD-2 is now a smaller, easier question, so it barely needs ratifying' has reproduced B-1's exact error at one remove — mistaking a scope correction for a gate exemption. This sentinel exists to catch that specific misreading in review, not merely to catch a text drift.

positive_controls.description: AMENDMENT ARM. THE RESIDUAL SWEEP IS ACTUALLY RE-RUNNABLE AND ITS RESULT REPRODUCIBLE. Re-executing a recursive string-leaf walk of the base authority v1.0.0, the authority amendment v1.0.1, and their two companion manifests against v1.0.2 RESIDUAL_SWEEP_METHOD’s eight patterns must produce exactly 19 unique loci (30 raw pattern hits, since several loci match more than one pattern), every one of which appears in exactly one of v1.0.2’s three classification lists (classified_hits_from_base_authority, classified_hits_from_authority_amendment_v101, classified_hits_from_base_manifest_v100). A hit outside all three lists means the sweep this control certifies is incomplete and ASEN102-1 has fired.

AMENDMENT ARM. OD-2's CORRECTED SUB-DECISION NO LONGER OFFERS THE PROHIBITED MECHANISM. Reading OWNER_DECISIONS[OD-2].sub_decisions[1] AS CORRECTED by v1.0.2 SPC102-1 must find it asks ONLY which PROCESS-SCOPED mechanism is selected, evaluated against SECRET_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.MECHANISM_2_PROCESS_SCOPED's five conditions, and must find it explicitly states that a user-scope persistent variable is NOT a candidate the sub-decision may select and that v1.0.1 SECTION_A7's adjudication of that mechanism is CLOSED. A reading that still finds the corrected text asking whether a user-scope variable is acceptable fails this control.

AMENDMENT ARM. THE CORRECTED TOKEN FIRES FOR THE GAP NB-2 FOUND. Construct the specific state NB-2 identified: MR-3 has FIRED (its trigger was met and its mutation issued), AND PV-27 (CREATE on public) is independently found TRUE for a reason unconnected to MR-3. Evaluate FAIL_CLOSED_TOKENS.STOP_UNEXPLAINED_PROHIBITED_PRIVILEGE.when AS CORRECTED by v1.0.2 SPC102-V101-3: disjunct (a) is false (MR-3 fired), disjunct (b) is false for PV-27 (MR_3_SCHEMA_USAGE_GRANT.verification never asserts PV-27), but disjunct (c) is TRUE (PV-27 is structurally outside MR-3’s causal reach regardless of firing) — so the token’s own written condition IS satisfied and STOP_UNEXPLAINED_PROHIBITED_PRIVILEGE fires. Evaluated against the PRE-v1.0.2 text, this exact state satisfies NEITHER disjunct and the token would NOT fire by the letter of the text; this control must show the CORRECTED text closes that gap.

negative_controls.description: A DEAD CLAUSE OFFERED AS CONTROLLING IS REFUSED. Citing OWNER_DECISIONS[OD-2].sub_decisions[1] in its PRE-v1.0.2 verbatim form ("...whether a Windows user-scope environment variable is accepted under the five binding conditions...") as though it were still the effective owner-decision text — for instance, in a ratification record, a credential-delivery implementation, or a future re-certification’s own summary — must be REFUSED. This is the exact failure mode the focused re-certification found: a clause superseded elsewhere in the document (SECTION_A7’s verdict) was still being read literally at its own location (OWNER_DECISIONS), because nothing at that location said otherwise.

THE RESTRICTIVE PRECEDENCE READING IS REFUSED. Reading v1.0.1 SECTION_A9_PRECEDENCE.rule as confining amendment control to ONLY the seven ids parenthesized in SECTION_A1 (F-A2-1, F-A2-2, F-A4, F-A4B, F-A5, F-A6, F-A7) — and therefore treating SECTION_A2's and SECTION_A3's own corrected prose-counts (four role-creating packages; eleven GRANT USAGE occurrences) as NOT controlling, with the base's original 'five packages'/'eight statements' still verbatim-controlling — must be REFUSED once v1.0.2 SPC102-V101-2 is in effect. A citation of the base's original miscounts as the controlling account, made after this amendment lands, fails this control.
